name: שברים חלקיים – (ax² + b)/(x·(x+c)²) (באנגלית)
generalfeedback:
Below are the rules of partial fractions.alg_partial_fractions

As a sum of partial fractions

\[ {{CT:0}}=\frac{A}{x}+\frac{B}{{CT:1}}+\frac{C}{{CT:2}},\]

and multiplying both sides through by {{CT:3}} we find

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:4}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:5}} + {{CT:6}} + {{CT:7}},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:8}} + {{CT:9}} + {{CT:10}} + {{CT:11}} + {{CT:12}} + {{CT:7}},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:13}} + {{CT:14}} + {{CT:10}}. \end{array}\] Matching coefficients \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle A + B&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:15}}\,\\ {{CT:16}} + C&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle 0,\\ {{CT:17}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:18}}. \end{array}\] So, \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle A&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:19}},\\ B&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:15}} - A = {{CT:15}} - {{CT:19}},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:20}},\\ C&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:21}} = {{CT:22}} - {{CT:23}},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:24}}. \end{array}\] Therefore, \[{{CT:0}}={{CT:25}}.\]
